'''Squall manintenace''' was the name given to funds collected as part of the [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrilian]] government's yearly public work budget which were put toward moving the large [[Squall (species)|squall]] population of Chandrila back out of cities and urban centers each year just after their mating season.
